item.title: Version 2.3.1
item.description:
What's New in 2.3.1

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed your password being rejected when unlocking this Mac remotely — If this Mac's screen had gone to sleep, a connected device could see the lock screen and type into it, but every password was refused as incorrect — even the right one. Typing on a keyboard plugged into the Mac was the only way in. Connecting now wakes the screen first, so your password is accepted the first time. This also covers the sign-in screen after a restart, and locking this Mac from your device is now safely reversible from that same device.
